reason: Source v1.24.0 already caps local RisingWave memory (2 GiB single_node budget, Docker limit 1 GiB above it, compactor limit from a mounted config), so the older 2 GiB container / 1.5 GiB budget hunk is not ported. The fixture config adds [system] checkpoint_frequency = 5 (one checkpoint of ~100 fsynced SSTs every 5 barriers: at every barrier the 54-step bootstrap was fsync-bound on a shared disk) and time_travel_retention_ms = 0 (nothing reads AS OF; the default made the meta store rewrite ~22k rows every 30 s). The first version of this patch (first superseded hash) put the whole state store in a 2 GiB tmpfs instead: on 2026-11-13 it grew from 0.46 GB to 1.5 GB in 2.5 h and host memory pressure swapped 4.3 GB of the container out. Web, seed and queries unchanged.
